## A captioned, cross-referenced figure

@fig-growth is written as an `infographic` code block. Icons are looked up by
name.

```{.infographic #fig-growth fig-cap="A customer growth engine." fig-alt="Three arrows: acquire, convert, retain."}
infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow
data
  title Customer Growth Engine
  desc Multi-channel reach and repeat purchases
  lists
    - label Acquire
      desc Paid channels and content marketing
      icon megaphone
    - label Convert
      desc Lead scoring and automated follow-up
      icon filter
    - label Retain
      desc Loyalty programme and renewals
      icon heart
```

## A sequence

```infographic
infographic sequence-steps-simple
data
  title Publishing workflow
  sequences
    - label Write
      desc Markdown and code
    - label Render
      desc Quarto and Pandoc
    - label Review
      desc Check every format
    - label Publish
      desc Share the result
```

## A comparison

```{.infographic width="90%"}
infographic compare-swot
data
  title SWOT analysis
  compares
    - label Strengths
      children
        - label Reproducible documents
        - label One source, many formats
    - label Weaknesses
      children
        - label Needs Node.js and Chrome
        - label Rendering takes a few seconds
    - label Opportunities
      children
        - label About 270 templates
        - label Themes and palettes
    - label Threats
      children
        - label Online icon and font services
        - label Young upstream library
```

## A chart

```{.infographic width="70%" fig-align="center"}
infographic chart-pie-donut-plain-text
data

      value 25

    - label Word
      value 10
```

## A hierarchy

```infographic
infographic hierarchy-tree-curved-line-rounded-rect-node
data
  title Extension layout
  root
    label antv-infographic
    children
      - label Lua filter
        children
          - label Collects code blocks
          - label Inserts images
      - label Node renderer
        children
          - label Headless Chrome
          - label SVG, PNG, PDF
```

## The hand-drawn theme

```{.infographic theme="hand-drawn" width="80%"}
infographic list-grid-badge-card
data
  title Why infographics
  lists
    - label Clear
      desc One idea per picture
      icon eye
    - label Fast
      desc Read in seconds
      icon lightning
    - label Memorable
      desc Shapes stick better than text
      icon brain

```
